title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Renewals: Length of the Burden Window After a Coverage Ends or a Short Award
content:
For a renewal application under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, the burden window's length in whole months depends on the household's coverage in Insurance Coverage & Claims and on the award being renewed. The burden window holds every entry dated fewer than that number of months before today, counted in whole calendar months from the entry's date to today.

**Guidance.**

1. A household whose ended coverage ended on or after that award's application date counts the whole months from the day that coverage ended to today, plus one. An ended coverage is a coverage in terminated status; the day it ended is its termination date.
2. A household with no coverage ended on or after that date, whose award runs no more than 6 months from its application date to its end date counted in whole months, and whose latest patient responsibility was posted on or after that award's application date, counts that award's whole months. The latest patient responsibility is the most recent posting of patient responsibility on the household's Patient Invoices & Statements.
3. For any other household this guidance does not change the window's length.

## Cases (hypothetical; today 15 September 2026; award being renewed applied for on 1 April 2026)

| Case | Facts on file | Window under this guidance |
|---|---|---|
| A | A coverage terminated on 10 June 2026 | 3 whole months from 10 June to 15 September, plus one: 4 months. Entries dated 16 May 2026 or later are in the window; an entry dated 15 May 2026 is not. |
| B | No coverage terminated on or after 1 April 2026; award runs 1 April 2026 to 1 October 2026 (6 whole months); latest patient responsibility posted 2 August 2026 | 6 months, the award's whole months |
| C | No coverage terminated on or after 1 April 2026; award runs 1 April 2026 to 1 April 2027 (12 whole months) | Not changed: the award runs more than 6 months |
| D | As in B, but the latest patient responsibility was posted on 20 March 2026 | Not changed: the latest posting is before the award's application date |
| E | A coverage terminated on 15 February 2026; award and postings as in B | The coverage ended before the award's application date, so point 1 does not apply; point 2 applies as in B: 6 months |

A coverage terminated on the award's application date itself counts under point 1, because point 1 takes a coverage that ended on or after that date.
